stores.name: Lam's Seafood
stores.about: An Asian grocery in the Chinatown–International District with a big fresh seafood counter, inexpensive meat and Asian produce. A second store is in Tukwila.
stores.delivery: Delivers groceries directly. Ask the store about the delivery area and how to order.

stores.name: Uwajimaya
stores.about: A Pacific Northwest Asian supermarket founded in 1928, best known for Japanese groceries, a seafood counter and a food hall.

stores.name: PCC Community Markets
stores.about: A member-owned natural foods co-op with stores across the Seattle area, strong on organic produce and local products. Anyone can shop.

stores.name: Central Co-op
stores.about: A member-owned co-op on East Madison Street in Seattle, with a second store in Tacoma. Organic and local produce and bulk foods.

stores.name: Smith Brothers Farms
stores.about: A Kent dairy that delivers milk, eggs and groceries to homes around Puget Sound. Not a store: sales run in two-week cycles.
stores.delivery: Home delivery is how they sell: groceries come with your milk order.

stores.name: Metropolitan Market
stores.about: A Seattle-area specialty grocery known for prepared foods, wine, and premium meat and produce.

stores.name: Red Apple Markets
stores.about: Independent neighborhood markets that share the Red Apple name. This site uses the Beacon Hill (Hilltop) store's flyer; other Red Apple stores may have different prices.

locations.label: Dominic's Red Apple (White Center area)
locations.address: 9627 Des Moines Memorial Dr S, Seattle

stores.name: H Mart
stores.about: A Korean-American supermarket chain with a big produce section, thin-sliced meats for Korean barbecue, and banchan. The Washington flyer covers the larger stores.

stores.name: T&T Supermarket
stores.about: A Canadian Asian supermarket chain with Washington stores in Bellevue and Lynnwood, known for its seafood counter, bakery and hot food.
stores.delivery: Delivers groceries directly from its Washington stores. Check their site for the delivery area and how to order.

stores.name: 99 Ranch Market
stores.about: A large Chinese and Taiwanese-American supermarket chain. The nearest stores are in Kent and Edmonds.

stores.name: Viet-Wah
stores.about: A Vietnamese and pan-Asian supermarket. Its original Chinatown–International District store closed in 2022; today's store is in Renton.

stores.name: Seafood City
stores.about: A Filipino supermarket chain. The Tukwila store at Westfield Southcenter has a seafood market, Filipino groceries and food stalls.

stores.name: Asian Family Market
stores.about: An Asian supermarket with stores on Aurora Avenue North in Seattle, in Bellevue and in Tukwila. Each store posts its own weekly poster.

seasons.label: Persimmons
seasons.name: Persimmon season
seasons.tagline: Fuyu are at their best now. Eat them crisp like an apple, skin and all.
facts: **Fuyu** are the squat, tomato-shaped ones. Eat them crisp like an apple, skin and all.
**Hachiya** are the acorn-shaped ones. Wait until they are soft as a water balloon, or they will make your whole mouth go dry.
Fuyu keep for a week or two on the counter and longer in the fridge.
Slice one sideways and you may find a little star in the middle.
Dried persimmons are called hoshigaki in Japan and gotgam in Korea.
